capabilities.rationale: Builds this producer's source_monitors federation export stream (thehub-pr ADR 0013): one row per source in reports/source_registry_status.csv, with its declared status, cadence and family, and when it last succeeded from a run receipt in data/source_run_state.json or reported as not recorded. It exposes no route, endpoint, control or operator workflow of its own; thehub-pr's Source Monitor renders the stream.
